summary: Skip every .github/workflows job on github.com and add one cheap GitHub-only job (github.yml), so hosted minutes cover Go tests, contracts, the tests/ suite and the documentation gate while the forge keeps running the full suite unchanged. API impact: none.

guide.reason: CI budget only; no operator workflow, GUI, CLI or installer behavior changes.

api.reason: No Controller/Core or client-facing contract is touched; only which runner executes existing checks.

roadmap.reason: No phase scope or build order change; the forge run remains the phase gate.

state.reason: No durable state is added or changed.

verification.method: Parsed all six .github workflows and listed each job's resolved condition (js-yaml): one job per file carries the github.com skip, phase1's six lanes carry it with the aggregator keeping always(), and github.yml's job carries the inverse. Added tests.test_ci_security.GitHubMinuteBudgetTests: it passes on the tree and fails in a copied tree with one job's condition removed. Measured the cheap job's content locally: go test ./... 43s, python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' 15s (three test_website_hosting failures are this workstation's missing nginx, which the job installs). Not verified: an actual hosted github.com run and an actual forge run; both are pending the next push.
